articles.title: AI Agents Spending Money Online? New Research Says Not Really
articles.snippet: TRM examined roughly $52.7 million across 198.9 million settlements using the x402 protocol. Most of it isn’t coming from AI agents, it says.

articles.title: AI Is Solving Math's Best Problems Faster Than They Can Be Replaced, Terence Tao Warns
articles.snippet: The Fields medalist points to a real race between OpenAI and Anthropic as proof: AI can now flatten a hard problem the moment someone starts working on it.
